name: Mie Kotsu Group Holdings, Inc.
summary: Mie Kotsu Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the transportation, real estate, distribution, and leisure service businesses in Japan and internationally. It offers transit and charter bus services; operates intercity express and limousine buses; and provides tour taxi services, as well as engages in the motor truck, automobile repair, insurance, advertising, tourist consulting, and rental businesses.
